scoring_method: Arithmetic mean of the six category scores, rounded to one decimal place.

category_findings.identity_and_footprint: Archives supports the ten-story MATH identity; GIS FID 227 bounding-edge agreement is within 0.00434 m, while sampled edge-distance maxima are about 1.54-1.95 m and the GIS is not a survey.
category_findings.placement_and_orientation: R8 read-only master registration evidence remains applicable because R9 reports no master edits; the single instance matches manifest translation within 0.02 m, with unit scale and zero rotation.
category_findings.roof_and_height: No measured elevation supports the 33.2 m shell, 42.9 m maximum, floor intervals, penthouse/monitor, parapets, roof, or mast. The prominent rooftop panels remain unsupported.
category_findings.exterior_and_texturing: R9 red-brown brick visually improves over R8's pale pink and matches the direction of the low-resolution Purdue photo; exact color is uncalibrated and photo orientation is unknown. Blank wings and opening schedule remain unverified.
category_findings.interior_and_circulation: R9 oblique is more legible and vertical alignment is internally consistent. Room layout, furniture, partitions, corridor widths/positions, stairs, and as-built circulation remain schematic.
category_findings.technical_integrity_and_verification: Blender reopen passed, collection and object counts recorded, shell bounds unchanged, connector present, material values reopened, and no unpacked images found. These do not prove architectural fidelity.

major_remaining_issues: No metric elevation source supports modeled height, floor spacing, roof, or penthouse geometry.
Broad blank facades and modeled openings outside the photographed elevation remain unverified.
Brick value is qualitative rather than calibrated; current exterior photo is low-resolution and not direction-identified.
Interior geometry and circulation are illustrative; no current as-built plan verifies room partitions, dimensions, or furniture layout.
recommended_next_evidence: A measured building elevation or facilities drawing identifying MATH.
Dated, direction-identified north and west facade photos or elevations.
A current as-built third-floor plan for partitions and circulation.
